welcome:
Your apps, one conversation away.
Choose a project, check its status, or ask your connected assistant. Use /openship help to see the commands available to this bot.
link: Open the link in the next message to connect your OpenShip account and choose its permissions. Then send the verification command shown on that page back here. The link expires in 10 minutes.
linked: Your OpenShip account is connected. Commands use only your approved permissions. Use /openship help to get started.
unlinked: Your chat account is disconnected. Use /openship link to connect again.
linkFirst: Connect your own OpenShip account first: /openship link
chooseProject: Choose a project to continue. You can also use its ID in a command.
noProjects: No projects are visible with your approved permissions. Create an app or review your access in OpenShip.
redeployEffect: The normal build and deployment checks will run.
noActive: This project has no active deployment. Deploy it in OpenShip first.
changed: This connection or deployment changed. Start the command again.
permissions: Your approved access does not allow this command. Review permissions in OpenShip.
notFound: Project or deployment not found, or unavailable with your access.
failed: This command could not be confirmed. Check the connection and deployment in OpenShip before trying again.
expired: This request expired or has already been used. Start again.
sameSender: Use the same account and conversation that requested this action.
interrupted: An earlier attempt may still be processing or was interrupted. Check OpenShip before requesting another action. It will not be replayed.
wrongRole: This command is not enabled for this bot. Use /openship help to see its commands.
assistantOff: Assistant chat is off. Enable your own agent in OpenShip → Settings → Chat apps.
helpHint: Choose a button below or use a command. Restart and redeploy always ask for confirmation. Logs open privately in OpenShip.
openFull: Open the conversation in OpenShip for the full response.

commands.link: Connect your account and choose permissions
commands.verify: Finish linking with the verification code
commands.chats: List your conversations in this chat
commands.resume: Continue a conversation by its ID

assistant.answerHere: Reply with /openship ask <answer>, or answer in OpenShip.
assistant.answerInApp: Answer these questions in OpenShip, then continue here.
assistant.stoppedOrFailed: This turn stopped or could not finish. Review the conversation before retrying.
assistant.finished: Your assistant finished. Review its findings and any access requests in OpenShip.
assistant.interrupted: This request was interrupted before it started. Send a new message.
assistant.timeLimit: This turn reached its time limit and was stopped.
assistant.empty: No conversation here yet. Use /openship ask <message> or /openship chats.
assistant.active: Your assistant is still working. Use /openship stop before switching chats.
assistant.new: New conversation. What would you like to work on? Earlier chats are available with /openship chats.
assistant.stopped: Stopped your assistant's current turn in this chat.
assistant.choose: Reply with one of the offered choices, or answer in OpenShip.
assistant.history: Open a conversation to read its history or continue in OpenShip.
